title: Canonical module-valued etale extension of a quasi-coherent module
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module. Its associated additive etale sheaf is the tensor-sections sheaf of [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. Define its module-valued realization over the small etale structure ring using the canonical ringed-site tensor extension of [def-sfb-scheme-zariski-etale-module-constructions]. Supply the continuity and right-adjoint-existence proof fields using the context provided by [lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence], and take $\epsilon^*\mathcal F$ for that context. Thus the definition is the existing canonical tensor extension, with no arbitrary sheaf or map chosen; the cited theorem identifies its underlying additive sheaf with the tensor-sections sheaf, compatibly with scalars, restrictions and the adjunction unit on every source open.
